claims.text: The PMO article of 28 September 2006 reports that the title of Crown Prince was vested 'yesterday' on the former Prince 'Ulukalala Lavaka Ata, in a ceremony at his residence, and that King Siaosi Tupou V also bestowed on him the noble title Tupouto'a; he is henceforth known as His Royal Highness Crown Prince Tupouto'a Lavaka, the heir apparent.
claims.uncertainty: No structured date: the vesting is dated only 'yesterday' relative to the article, and 27 September 2006 would be derived. An identity observation linking the 2012 proclamation's 'Crown Prince Tupouto'a Lavaka' to his earlier name; not an accession or a to_king holder observation.
